moworks.notes: Arrow rides an arc and turns to its tangent (θ = atan2(dy, dx) from the same progress). Recipe: 1000 ms sine.inOut, x 0 → 90 → 180, y 0 → −70 → 0, rotation −28° → 0 → +28°. Small demo: the steeper arc of arc-travel (−50° → +50°) at constant speed in 2200 ms; the travelled part draws as a 2 px accent line, the rest dashed. Params: duration (1 s) · path: đường SVG · rotate: xoay theo hướng (true) · ease (sine.inOut).
moworks.titleVi: Đi theo đường, xoay theo hướng
